source.contract: While a submission is pending, do not expose a failure state or make a second attempt appear available until the original request resolves.

target.contract: The shared helper rejects a concurrent call; handlers must short-circuit on their disabled submit control before changing feedback state.

resolutionEvidence.implemented: Added early disabled-button guards to CmsNewsletter, Footer, StaticLeadPage, CampaignLeadForm, and PublicCampaignPage. Footer and CampaignLeadForm now disable their submit controls during their existing request and restore them after ordinary error responses.
resolutionEvidence.runtime: PublicCampaignPage actual handler test verifies one pending fetch; duplicate submission leaves the button disabled, form visible, feedback empty and redirect absent until the first response. A 503 exposes the existing error and allows retry; only the later 202 redirects.
resolutionEvidence.parentOwnedConsumer: Root added an early `if (!button || button.disabled) return` in CmsPropertyInquiry immediately after preventDefault and before validation, feedback changes, or payload construction. The static guard assertion now covers it; the actual-handler feedback runtime test still covers its rejection and 202 paths. A duplicate-pending runtime case is asserted for PublicCampaignPage, not CmsPropertyInquiry.
resolutionEvidence.tests: node --test tests/forms/cms-form-feedback-runtime.test.mjs tests/migration/static-contract-fixes.test.mjs: 7/7 passed. The earlier shared form regression suite passed 23/23 before this root-owned one-line guard.
